youtube.title: Why Is the Sky Blue but the Sunset Red? #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Space is black and sunlight is white, so why is the sky blue? And why does the same sky turn red at sunset? (It's not the ocean.)

From John Tyndall's glowing tube of mist in 1859 and Lord Rayleigh's maths, to why the sky isn't violet and why Mars has blue sunsets, this is the physics behind the colours above your head.

instagram.caption:
The sky isn't blue because of the ocean. 🌅

Sunlight bounces off the air itself: blue scatters ~6x more than red. At sunset the light travels so far that the blue is gone. And on Mars, sunsets are blue.

Full story on our YouTube channel.
